coordinates: PDF points, origin top-left, y grows downward. Underscore run: the run's character box. Drawn rule: the rule's x extent and the 10 pt of writing room above it. Cell or box: its printed edges. Tick box: the printed square.
how_measured: Picture pages: rules and squares found as ink components in each embedded JPEG at its own resolution, converted to PDF points through the drawing matrix; every picture looked at; overlays looked at.

third_parties: firm internal use: RR, AML compliance and principal approval (page 2)
signing.kind: Two-page subscription application (Gabelli Go Anywhere Trust), each page one 96 dpi picture. The client(s) sign one line; joint owner, custodian or trustee details have their own lines; the "For Internal Use Only" block is the dealer's.
signing.note: Pictures are 649x840 px drawn at 0.75 pt per pixel (page 1 at x 63, y 47.25; page 2 at x 63, y 48). The "For Internal Use Only" places are counted as third-party per the brief.

sure_per_page.1: sure of every place; the address line with five captions under it is kept as one place (marked); the second Name line is read as a co-investor (it is captioned joint owner/custodian/trustee)
sure_per_page.2: sure; the wire reference rule is a judgement (kept, marked)

1: the tiny garbled text layer printed at the bottom-left of the page (an alt-text layer, 0.5 pt)
the short underline inside the identity-verification heading
2: the tiny garbled text layer at the bottom-left
